item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Sept. 6)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: American Airlines passenger duct taped to seat after lashing out mid-flight
item.description: A man was duct-taped to his first-class seat on an American Airlines flight and later arrested after allegedly exhibiting violent behavior, and forcing the flight to be diverted. Kris Van Cleave has the story.

item.title: Powerful storms, heat waves hit several states ahead of Labor Day weekend
item.description: Labor Day weekend travel is set to be disrupted by powerful storms across the country. Lana Zak reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Powerful storms, heat waves hit several states ahead of Labor Day weekend
item.description: Labor Day weekend travel is set to be disrupted by powerful storms across the country. Lana Zak reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: What happens next as judge in Lindsay Clancy case declares mistrial over hung jury
item.description: The Massachusetts trial of Lindsay Clancy, the mother charged with murdering her three young children, ended in a hung jury on Friday. Shanelle Kaul reports and Caroline Polisi has legal analysis.

item.title: Illinois senators blast FAA for holding air traffic controller raises "hostage"
item.description: The Homeland Security and Further Additional Continuing Appropriations Act set aside​ $140 million to give controllers a 3.8% pay raise, but they have so far only received the 1% raise given to all government employees.

item.title: Venus and Serena Williams return to US Open to compete in women's doubles
item.description: Famous sisters Venus and Serena Williams are among the many Americans competing in this year's US Open tennis tournament. CBS News' Jared Ochacher has more.

item.title: Serena and Venus Williams return to U.S. Open women's doubles tournament tonight
item.description: Serena and Venus Williams will play together at the U.S. Open in New York for the first time in four years.

item.title: Millions of Labor Day travelers facing higher gas prices and airfare
item.description: Millions of Americans are set to face higher gas prices and higher airfare this Labor Day weekend due to disruptions connected to the Iran war and other conflicts. CBS News senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: Think tank won't retract report on National Guard and crime amid Trump lawsuit threat, CEO says
item.description: President Trump is threatening a defamation lawsuit against the left-leaning think tank, Center for American Progress, over its new report that found National Guard deployments didn't reduce violent crime. Neera Tanden, the think tank's CEO and a former adviser to former President Joe Biden, joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Judge lets LSU add ex-NFL players to team's roster
item.description: A judge ruled Thursday night that the Louisiana State University football team could roster two players who had brief stints with NFL teams. Attorneys for the Southeastern Conference say they plan to file an appeal. Yahoo Sports senior writer Ross Dellenger joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: American Airlines passenger duct-taped to seat after mid-flight outburst
item.description: A picture shows the man with multiple loops of tape around his wrists, torso and head.

item.title: Clancy trial ends in hung jury after attorney's attempt to avoid mistrial fails
item.description: A mistrial was declared in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial Friday, after her attorney's last-minute appeal failed.

item.title: How the Lindsay Clancy murder case arrived at a mistrial
item.description: Was Lindsay Clancy legally responsible for the killing of her three young children? After 41 days, we are no closer to an answer as the judge has ruled a mistrial. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and Caroline Polisi break down how the case ended with a hung jury.

item.title: 9/4: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Judge declares mistrial in Lindsay Clancy murder case; U.S. employers add 162,000 jobs in August.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's defense attorney speaks out after mistrial declaration
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's criminal defense attorney, Kevin Reddington, held a news conference on Friday after a judge declared a mistrial in the case. Watch his full remarks.

item.title: Psychiatrist says Lindsay Clancy trial has "shown how much maternal mental healthcare is needed"
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial has sparked conversations around maternal and postnatal health. Dr. Mary Kimmel, a psychiatrist who specializes in treating women during pregnancy and the postpartum period, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy supporter calls mistrial decision "devastating"
item.description: CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul spoke with Renee Kimbal, a supporter of Lindsay Clancy, on Friday after a judge declared a mistrial in the case.

item.title: Chief Lindsay Clancy prosecutor says case "is not about the healthcare system" after mistrial
item.description: Plymouth County District Attorney Tim Cruz took questions from reporters on Friday after a judge declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case. Watch his full remarks.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial attendee reacts to mistrial: "It doesn't resolve anything"
item.description: The judge in the Lindsay Clancy murder case declared a mistrial on Friday after the jury was unable to reach a unanimous verdict. CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul spoke with one woman who attended the trial.

item.title: Legal expert explains what could happen next in Lindsay Clancy case after mistrial
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial officially ended in a mistrial on Friday after the defense's appeal was denied. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson joins with analysis.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder case ends in mistrial after SJC denies emergency appeal
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial ended in a mistrial Friday, after jurors announced for a third time that they were unable to reach a unanimous verdict.

item.title: Mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial | Special Report
item.description: Plymouth Superior Court Judge William Sullivan has declared a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial. Clancy pleaded not guilty to first-degree murder in the deaths of her children in their Duxbury home in January 2023. Tony Dokoupil anchored this CBS News special report.

item.title: Gas prices surge just before Labor Day, as diesel hits record high
item.description: Diesel hit a record of $5.85 a gallon Friday, eclipsing its prior mark of $5.81, set in June 2022.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy jury leaves without verdict, defense wants juror dismissed
item.description: A sixth day of jury deliberations in Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial ended Thursday without a verdict.

item.title: Clancy trial highlights need to rethink postpartum care: "The duty is on the system"
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's case is resonating with moms across the U.S. — bringing into focus the spectrum of perinatal mood and anxiety disorders​ and the lack of resources for many women.

item.title: Key moments from Lindsay Clancy's trial as jury weighs the case
item.description: Lindsay Clancy, 36, has pleaded not guilty to first-degree murder in the deaths of her three children and said she was suffering form postpartum psychosis. A jury is deliberating.

item.title: Mom says postpartum psychosis made her feel like "such a monster"
item.description: As the trial of Lindsay Clancy brings renewed attention to postpartum psychosis, Haley Ashcom shares her experience with the dangerous condition.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy said a voice ordered her to kill children, psychologist testifies
item.description: A psychologist who met with Lindsay Clancy in the hospital after her children's deaths testified Tuesday at her murder trial in Massachusetts.

item.title: "Pink flags" of postpartum psychosis — and more takeaways from "Healthful"
item.description: Perinatal psychiatrist Dr. Uruj Kamal Haider and Kriti Lodha joined a special edition of "Healthful" to talk more about mental health conditions, including postpartum psychosis​.
